regionalNotesEnglish: France/Québec roofing terminology and power-tool safety require qualified regional/trade review.
Confirm manufacturer nailing zones, fastener pattern, repair and tool settings; this scene is not a work procedure.
archivedDraft.status: separate unapproved draft; no answer, audio or progress inheritance

sourceDecisionQuestions.question: Source nail pattern, fastener and product instructions need matching trade/dictionary senses. Archived schéma de clouage and fixation may not denote the same fastening detail; confirm product-specific terminology before scoring.
The Reader explicitly uses asphalt shingles while the card English says shingle; archived bardeau alone is broader. Confirm contextual dictionary sense and whether the card needs asphalt specificity.
Four nails per shingle is only the guide's attributed language example. Confirm the actual manufacturer's nail quantity, zones and pattern before any scored construction instruction or audio script.

The source says to use the same pattern on every shingle after confirming this product's instructions. Preserve that order and product scope; do not generalize the pattern across products or roof systems.

The wrapper and product instructions are the source of the actual pattern. Verify regional packaging terminology and how the instruction is presented without implying the package alone resolves site-specific requirements.
